notes.title: Shoomer Booter – Full Release Coming Late August
notes.notes:
Shoomer Booter began its journey in Early Access with Episode 1 and 10 levels. 

Now the second and final episode is ready, adding another 10 levels for a total of 20.



What’s new:
• 3 new enemy types
• Fixed reported bugs and errors
• Improved sound design and overall game performance

• 4k resolution support

• added FOV adjustments and mouse sensitivity and inversion
• Updated UI – hero portrait now changes with every 10% drop in health, just like in the classics
• Each arena now has a shop where you decide what to buy before the fight: ammo, weapons, health, armor, or nothing at all if you want to save money for later
• Every level has 3 secrets – 60 in total
• New challenges: teleports, lava fields, lifts, arena battles, mazes, and color-coded key cards
• Many achievements to unlock



If you’re looking for everything, expect 200 to 400 minutes of gameplay. 

The full release will be available with a 20% launch discount during the last week of August 2025.



To everyone following the project, thank you. Your interest kept this game alive. I appreciate all forms of feedback, whether it’s bug reports, balance suggestions, or general impressions.



A quick note on the timeline: Episode 2 took much longer than planned. The actual gap between episodes shouldn’t have been a year, but I had to pause development due to some personal family losses. Now I’m back on track and focused on delivering the best version of Shoomer Booter I can.



See you in the arenas.

notes.title: May 11. Demo build update (v 0.5)
notes.notes:
Hello, Boomers!

It’s been a while since my last update. Game development is my hobby, but some unexpected events recently disrupted my work on 'Shoomer Booter.'

I had a bout with a covid-like virus (yes, for the second time, with eerily similar symptoms). Following that, I had to divert my focus to job hunting, navigating through screening interviews, test assignments, technical interviews, even C-level discussions, and more.

But now that I've recovered from the virus and secured a job offer, I'm excited to dive back into my passion project. While a few minor features may need to wait, the game's release date remains unchanged.

I’d love to hear about your experiences playing the game!

P.S.
I’ve also submitted 'Shoomer Booter' to some indie game festivals. Organizers requested actual gameplay footage (as the current trailer doesn’t capture it accurately). So, I’ve prepared a walkthrough of Episode 1: Level 7, which you can watch on YouTube. It offers a sneak peek at what’s coming soon!

--
Cheers,
Tommy Gun Walrus

notes.title: Update after 'Saint Phoenix' feedback
notes.notes:
Hello Boomers!

Player 'Saint Phoenix' provided meaningful feedback after the playing session.
So I delivered some fixes:


 Decreased health for enemies: 'Brain-Bug', 'Melee Imp', 'Ranged Imp';
 Added more small health pickup
 Added more small armor pickup
 Added a few more ammo pickups
 Increased values at some existing ammo pickups
 Added 'breadcrumbs' leading to a secret area (near lava)
 Fixed layout so level could reach secret area even with a 'broken' lift
 Small fix on 'broken' lift/platform
 Added capture reflections (graphic improvement)
 Some other minor changes


On average, players, even without finding secret areas with big ammo supplies, could manage to complete the demo level without grinding-punching enemies.

Small hints:
Lava does not kill instantly;
The player could shoot at barrels to blow them up and damage enemies nearby thus spending only 1 shot instead of 4-10
Secrets located at level - could significantly increase chances to finishing level.

Feel free to share your playing experience!
--
Cheers,
Tommy Gun Walrus

notes.title: Upcoming Demo version of "Shoomer Booter"
notes.notes:
Hello, Shoomers and Booters!


The demo version of the game will be available soon. 

It will be tiny (~250 MB in size) and contains  Episode  1 Mission 0, aka "E1M0" (granny explanation for youngest shooters).
There will be about 15 minutes of playtime - fair enough to understand what players could expect from the upcoming Early Access version of the game.

A few minor known issues could be present in "Demo build", but as a solo indie dev - I promise that every reported bug/issue or any meaningful feedback will be carefully considered for immediate fixing or placing into the game 'backlog' and further. 

BTW backlog contains 136 tasks/points of improvement. And ~30 of those 136 should be done before releasing the 'early access version'. So there are some queues of tasks that will be delivered in the next builds (but critical bugs and show-stoppers will be fixed immediately).

So feel free to share your opinion about "Shoomer Booter"!

Cheers,
Tommy Gun Walrus
